fields.DiscardModalBody: Are you sure you want to cancel the form? If you do, all progress will be lost and you will have to start again.
fields.HelpDescription: You can report your claim or incident here. If you need to speak to the claims team, all their details are below:
fields.YourDetailsSectionDescription: Enter your contact details so we can keep you updated about your claim.
fields.PolicySectionDescription: Your service number is linked to your policy, so we've grouped them together.
fields.PolicyNumberFormatError: Policy number must start with 'TRI' followed by 10 digits (e.g. TRI1234567890)
fields.PolicyNumberFieldInfo: Found on your policy documents or insurance certificate. Leave blank if unknown.
fields.ProductFieldInfo: The insurance product that covers this claim.
fields.ServiceNumberFieldInfo: Your unique military service number, used to verify your identity and link your policy.
fields.ErrServiceNumberFormat: Service number must be in the format SA12345678 (2 uppercase letters followed by 8 digits)
fields.SpouseDetailsDescription: Provide the details of the policyholder's spouse.
fields.DependentDetailsDescription: Provide the details of the dependent you are claiming on behalf of.
fields.AuthorisedPersonDetailsDescription: Provide the details of the authorised person submitting this claim.
fields.AdditionalDetailsDescription: Please provide your details and describe your relationship to the policyholder.
fields.Describe your relationship to the policy: Describe your relationship to the policyholder
fields.DescribeRelationshipPH: e.g. Executor, Legal guardian, Power of attorney
fields.ErrDateOfBirthFuture: Date of birth cannot be in the future
fields.ErrDependentRelationshipRequired: Please describe the dependent's relationship to the policyholder
fields.ErrOtherRelationshipDescriptionRequired: Please describe your relationship to the policyholder
fields.EmailAddressFieldInfo: We'll use this email to send you claim updates and important communications.
fields.PhoneNumberFieldInfo: We may call you if we need more information about your claim.
fields.PolicyholderAddressSectionDescription: Enter the address where you usually live.
fields.YourDetailsInstruction: Please provide the policyholder's contact details and policy information. If you are claiming on behalf of someone else, select your relationship to the policyholder. All required fields are marked with an asterisk.
fields.WhatHappenedInstructions: Tell us what happened, when it happened, and where the incident took place. Accurate details help us process your claim more efficiently. If a crime was involved, please include any police reference number.
fields.IncidentDetailsDescription: Tell us what and when the incident happened so we can assess your claim.
fields.DateOfLossFieldInfo: Enter the date the incident or loss occurred. If unsure, use your best estimate.
fields.IncidentTypeFieldInfo: Select the category that best describes what happened to your item or property.
fields.ReportedToPolice: Was this theft reported to the police?
fields.HowDidItHappenFieldInfo: Describe the incident, including what happened, where it occurred, and any important details that may help us assess your claim. Maximum 500 characters.
fields.WhereDidThisHappenDescription: Select where the loss occurred, whether at your registered address, on deployment, during an exercise, or at another location.
fields.ItemsAffectedInstruction: List each item you are claiming for, including a description, age, purchase price, and replacement cost. Adding as much detail as possible will help us assess your claim quickly and fairly.
fields.ItemCoverTypeFieldInfo: Select the category of cover that applies to this item under your policy
fields.ItemTypeFieldInfo: Select the specific type of item you are claiming for.
fields.ClaimedAmountFieldInfo: Enter the amount you are claiming. This should reflect the current replacement value, not the original purchase price.
fields.ItemDescPH: Dell Latitude 5520 Laptop, 15.6", Intel Core i5, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD
fields.PurchasePriceFieldInfo: The original price you paid for this item.
fields.AddNewItemDescription: Enter the details of the item you're claiming for. Accurate information helps us assess your claim more quickly.
fields.EditItemDescription: Update the details of this item. Accurate information helps us assess your claim more quickly.
fields.SavedItemsDescription: Review, edit, or remove items you've added.
fields.EvidenceInstruction: Upload up to 20 images to support your claim. The most useful evidence includes clear photos of the item, damage, proof of purchase, proof of ownership, repair estimates, or relevant incident reports. Clear, legible documents help us review your claim faster. We will contact you if we need more information.
fields.DragDropInstruction: Drag and drop files here, or click to select
fields.MaxFileSizeExceeded: Each file must be less than 10 MB
fields.NoEvidenceAvailable: You can still submit your claim if you don't have evidence available right now.
fields.ReviewInstructions: Review the information you've provided before submitting your claim. You can expand any section to check the details or make changes.
fields.FPNText: To help protect our customers and prevent fraud, we may use the information you provide to verify your identity, review claims history and carry out checks with fraud prevention agencies, Insurers, public records and other relevant organisations. We may also share information with these organisations where appropriate and receive information from them.
fields.FPNText2: These checks help us verify policy and claim information and support the prevention and detection of fraud.
fields.PrivacyPolicyNoticeText: For more information about how we process your personal information, please refer to our
fields.CACText: I confirm that the information I have provided is true, complete and accurate to the best of my knowledge and belief.
fields.CACText2: I understand that providing false or misleading information may result in my claim being declined and may affect my insurance cover. Where fraud is suspected or identified, information may be shared with fraud prevention agencies, public authorities, insurers and other relevant organisations.
fields.DeclarationConsentText: I confirm that the information provided is accurate and that I have read and understood the Fraud Prevention & Detection Notice.
fields.ConfirmationNeedSupportIntro: If you have any questions regarding your claim, please contact our Claims Team and quote your claim reference number.
